description: This file defines models and logic for managing repair orders in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including calculations for amounts, invoice creation, state transitions, and related entities like repair lines and fees.

classes.name: mrp_repair
classes.description: Model for managing repair orders, including state transitions, invoice creation, and amount calculations.

classes.name: ProductChangeMixin
classes.description: Mixin providing product_id_change method for product-related updates.

classes.name: mrp_repair_line
classes.description: Model for individual repair operation lines, including amount calculations and operation type changes.

classes.name: mrp_repair_fee
classes.description: Model for repair fee lines, including amount calculations.

methods.name: _amount_untaxed
methods.description: Calculates untaxed amount for repair, summing operation and fee subtotals.

methods.name: _amount_tax
methods.description: Calculates total tax amount for repair based on invoiceable lines.

methods.name: _amount_total
methods.description: Calculates total amount including taxes.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a repair record with reset state and sequence number.

methods.name: onchange_product_id
methods.description: Resets related fields when product is changed.

methods.name: onchange_move_id
methods.description: Updates guarantee limit, locations, and partner info based on selected stock move.

methods.name: button_dummy
methods.description: Placeholder method, returns True.

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Updates address and pricelist based on selected partner.

methods.name: onchange_lot_id
methods.description: Updates move and location info based on selected lot.

methods.name: action_cancel_draft
methods.description: Resets repair to draft state and workflow.

methods.name: action_confirm
methods.description: Confirms repair, updates state, and confirms operation lines.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels repair and operation lines.

methods.name: wkf_invoice_create
methods.description: Triggers invoice creation workflow.

methods.name: action_invoice_create
methods.description: Creates invoices for repair, including invoice lines for operations and fees.

methods.name: action_repair_ready
methods.description: Sets repair state to 'ready'.

methods.name: action_invoice_cancel
methods.description: Sets repair state to 'invoice_except'.

methods.name: action_repair_start
methods.description: Sets repair state to 'under_repair'.

methods.name: action_invoice_end
methods.description: Finalizes invoice process, updates repair state.

methods.name: action_repair_end
methods.description: Marks repair as repaired, updates state based on invoicing method.

methods.name: wkf_repair_done
methods.description: Workflow trigger for repair completion.

methods.name: action_repair_done
methods.description: Completes repair, creates stock moves, and optionally creates delivery picking.

methods.name: product_id_change
methods.description: Updates product details, price, and tax info based on selected product.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Copies repair line or fee with default reset fields.

methods.name: _amount_line
methods.description: Calculates subtotal for repair line or fee.

methods.name: onchange_operation_type
methods.description: Updates source/destination locations and invoice flag based on operation type.
